cheatsheet.ex: I'm following up on my interview last Tuesday.
I sent a thank-you note the same day.
I just wanted to touch base about the position.
Where are you in the hiring process?
Could you tell me about the next steps?
I remain very interested in the role.
Is there a timeline for the decision?
Please keep me in mind for future roles.

cards.explain: Короткое письмо в тот же день — сильный плюс ✉️

cards.front: Is there a timeline for the decision?

audio.text: We're still interviewing a few candidates and expect to decide by the end of next week.

cards.explain: expect to decide by — планируют решить к… 📅

audio.text: Unfortunately, we've decided to move forward with another candidate.

cards.explain: Вежливая формула отказа. Ответь с благодарностью 🙏

cards.prompt: Я хотел(а) уточнить статус по моему интервью.
Я по-прежнему очень заинтересован(а) в этой роли.

cards.text: Thank you for your time yesterday. I really enjoyed learning about the team.
cards.tr: Спасибо за вчерашнюю встречу. Мне было очень интересно узнать о команде.

cards.text: Hi, I just wanted to touch base about the support role. I remain very interested. Is there a timeline for the decision?
cards.tr: Здравствуйте, хотел(а) уточнить по позиции в поддержке. Я по-прежнему очень заинтересован(а). Есть ли сроки решения?

n1.say: Hi, this is Maya from BrightHire. How can I help?
n1.tr: Здравствуйте, это Майя из BrightHire. Чем могу помочь?

choices.text: Hi Maya, this is Alex. I'm following up on my interview for the support role last Tuesday.

choices.feedback: Слишком в лоб. Сначала представься и назови позицию 🙂

n2.say: Oh yes, hi Alex! Thanks for the thank-you note, by the way.
n2.tr: О да, привет, Алекс! Кстати, спасибо за письмо с благодарностью.

choices.text: My pleasure. I really enjoyed meeting the team. Could you tell me about the next steps?
No problem. So, is there any news?
choices.feedback: Нормально, но мягче: Could you tell me about the next steps?

n3.say: We're finishing the last interviews this week, and we expect to decide by Friday.
n3.tr: Мы заканчиваем последние интервью на этой неделе и планируем решить к пятнице.

choices.text: That's great to know. I remain very interested in the role.
Is there anything else I can send to support my application?

n4.say: Good to hear. If anything changes, I'll let you know right away.
n4.tr: Приятно слышать. Если что-то изменится, сразу сообщу.

choices.text: Thank you. And if it's not a match this time, please keep me in mind for future roles.
choices.feedback: Профессионально и с запасом на будущее 🙌

choices.text: Perfect, thanks. I'll wait for your email then.
